title: fix(plugin-list,plugin-map,plugin-timeline): record preview overlay mounts RecordDetailPanel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DCGwwEawzsvTN8uZT5wRTP8)_

Part of #13458 — the overlay fix (the card's deliverable) and two of its helper collapses land here; the verdict-cache merge and the `formatDate` collapse are stopped and reported below, so #13458 remains open for them.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

- **Record preview overlay** — `ListView`, `ObjectGallery` (plugin-list), `ObjectMap` (plugin-map) and `ObjectTimeline` (plugin-timeline) now mount `RecordDetailPanel` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` inside their `NavigationOverlay`, as `ObjectGrid`, `ObjectTree`, `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectCalendar` and `ObjectGantt` already do. The record reads with declared labels, typed widgets and the object's field order, and `hidden` fields stay hidden. Read-only, as on the grid and the tree (capability is handler presence; these views hand the panel no write path). A row with no object name or no string/number id keeps the plain key/value reading, as the tree's and grid's fallbacks do. `plugin-list`, `plugin-map` and `plugin-timeline` gain the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` edge the five other plugins carry (`package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`).
- **`GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING`** — one copy, exported from `@object-ui/core` (`utils/gantt-config-spelling.ts`); `ListView` and `ObjectView` import it. Neither package depends on the other, so core is the lower layer both reach. Byte-identical table; no behaviour change.
- **`isSameAuthoredFilter`** — exported from `@object-ui/react` (`useResolvedFilter.ts`); `ObjectGrid` drops its byte-identical copy (and its private `isPlainFilterObject` / depth constant) and imports it.
- **`isPlainObject`** — added to `@object-ui/core` with the majority reading (`typeof === 'object'`, non-null, not an array). Per the claim, locals are replaced only in files this PR already touches; none of them carries one, so no local is replaced here.
- Docs: `packages/plugin-detail/README.md` (the renderer list) and `content/docs/guide/user-state-persistence.md` (the overlay authoring note). Changeset `.changeset/13458-record-preview-panel.md` (patch).

## Stopped and reported (not mechanical)

- **Verdict cache merge** (`plugin-detail/src/useRecordEditable.ts` vs `plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRecordCrudVerdicts.ts`): the two are not copies of one behaviour. The detail cache asks one record per `POST` (`body.recordId`, answer `record.visible`) and stales a whole probe; the grid cache batches (`body.recordIds`, answer `records[i]`, echoed id checked), stales and re-checks per row, and keys pending entries per row on a `Promise<void>`. One shared map would also make a grid row's verdict the record page's synchronous initial state and the reverse — a behaviour change. Not touched; the seat's call.
- **`formatDate` → `formatDateTime`** (AuditLogPage, ApprovalsInboxPage, RecordApprovalsPanel): the local is `new Date(s).toLocaleString(locale)` ("3/4/2020, 3:30:00 PM"); `@object-ui/i18n`'s `formatDateTime` medium style drops seconds and spells the month ("Mar 4, 2020, 3:30 PM"), and no style reproduces the current face. `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` pins the current face (`/3\/4\/2020, 3:30:00\sPM/`, `/4\.3\.2020, 15:30:00/`). A visible format change on an audit timestamp is not mechanical. Not touched.

## Tests

- New: `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/recordPreviewPanel-13458.test.tsx` (ListView + ObjectGallery + the no-object fallback), `packages/plugin-map/src/__tests__/recordPreviewPanel-13458.test.tsx`, `packages/plugin-timeline/src/__tests__/recordPreviewPanel-13458.test.tsx`, `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/is-plain-object.test.ts`.
- Reverse check (one-off, at 34f867e): restoring the four overlay files from `cd70b78` turned the four panel rows red (`Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`; the fallback row passes both ways, as intended); restored, green.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-map/ packages/plugin-timeline/` plus `useResolvedFilter.test.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.filterContextTokens-10607.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.readersRetired-6152.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.namedViewProtocolKeys-8980.test.tsx`, `packages/core/src/utils/` → `Test Files 357 passed (357)`, `Tests 4445 passed | 37 skipped (4482)`.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check` over core, react, plugin-grid, plugin-list, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-view → `24 successful, 24 total`.

## Gates run locally

`check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:self-import`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: exit 0. `eslint` over the changed `.ts`/`.tsx`: 0 errors (warnings pre-existing). NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, reason: it needs every package's `dist` built (the run named unbuilt plugin-calendar / plugin-gantt / plugin-kanban type entries, none touched here); CI builds first.

## Acceptance notes

- `RecordDetailPanel.tsx`'s own docblock still says "all five list-type renderers"; left alone because the claim keeps `RecordDetailPanel` internals with objectui#13386. The README now lists all nine.
- The four overlays' raw-dump fallback is still four inline copies (now reached only by rows without an object name or id); the tree and grid carry their own variants. No shared fallback was introduced.
- `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING` and `pickFlatMapConfig` are also duplicated between `ListView.tsx` and `ObjectView.tsx`; not named by the card, so left as they are. Carrier: none.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
